features: SIZE FIRST - Diesel Ultrahuman Ring sizes are different from standard ring sizes. Purchase the Sizing Kit first to find your perfect fit — available in 10 sizes from 5-14.

FORM & FUNCTION FULLY IN SYNC - Diesel’s iconic style meets Ultrahuman's precision health technology in this limited edition smart ring for those who carry their power and flaunt it like a bold statement. The Double-D design paired with intelligent insights makes this more than a smart ring: it’s fashion of the future.

COMFORT FOR THE EVERYDAY - Forged with space-grade Titanium, the Diesel Ultrahuman Ring is built to last yet features a comfortable form factor. The inner shell is made of hypoallergenic material which effortlessly houses 6-Axis Motion Sensor, a PPG (Photoplethysmography) Sensor, and a medical-grade Temperature Sensor – all without compromising on how it pairs with your wardrobe.

AN EXTENSION OF YOU - The Diesel Ultrahuman Ring brings pure performance to meet your personality. Phantom (Distressed Black) embodies an elusive and gritty presence – industrial at heart, refined in form. Cryo (Shiny Silver) reflects the integration of protocols in the bleeding edge of health and fashion – icy in tone, effortless in presence.

ADVANCED SLEEP INSIGHTS - Diesel Ultrahuman Ring is the perfect form factor to track your sleep. With insights on all your sleep stages – REM, Deep Sleep, Light Sleep and Wakefulness – get actionable steps to improve sleep so you're ready for the day.
